Jinhsimod:Drscale.NAME: Loong Scale
Jinhsimod:Drscale.FLAVOR: Jinhsi once drowned in a dream, clinging to driftwood, riding the reverse tidal flow back to shore.When she woke up, what she was holding in her hand was a piece of scale. If you look closely, you'll notice that the scale looks similar.to the ones on the Sentinel's body..
DESCRIPTIONS: Each time you attack an enemy, gain 1 #ykeyword:incandescence. NL Each time you play an Attack card, gain 1 #ykeyword:chrono-rhyme .

Jinhsimod:HJJCsheng.NAME: Luminal Synthesis
DESCRIPTIONS: Has 6 tiers of special effects. Each #ykeyword:convene unlocks 1 tier.
Tier 1: For every 10 Incandescence gained, draw 1 card
Tier 2: At the start of turn, gain 5 Incandescence
Tier 3: At the start of combat, gain 4 chrono-rhyme.
Tier 4: At the end of turn, gain Block equal to half of your Incandescence
Tier 5: Gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity for every 35 Incandescence gained
Tier 6: At the start of combat, gain #ykeyword:thawing-triumph

Jinhsimod:XLbao.NAME: Loong Bun
Jinhsimod:XLbao.FLAVOR: A plate of Loong Buns made by Loong Bun Jinhsi herself, each adopting a pink hue and a sprinkling of osmanthus powdered sugar.
DESCRIPTIONS: Unlocks your Incandescence cap. Effects that spend Incandescence now reduce it by 50 instead.

Jinhsimod:YueKa.NAME: Lunar Observation Card
Jinhsimod:YueKa.FLAVOR: A token for tracking lunar phases.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain 3 Gold and add a Huanyu card to your hand. At the start of the turn, lose 1/3 of the stacks of keyword:incandescence

Jinhsimod:DBSxiang.NAME: To-Do List
Jinhsimod:DBSxiang.FLAVOR: The Chancellor is always busy - night deployments, Celestial Engineering affairs... So Jinxi asked the Huaxu Research Institute to develop a portable to-do list for reviewing documents while on the go.
DESCRIPTIONS: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn and trigger 1 instance of #ykeyword:chrono-rhyme .
